crop.notes: Headline ('Mitchell Is a Cinch. That Is the Opinion of Statesman Jim Cronin') and most of the deck are cut off; clipping starts at the last deck line. Body complete through 'Domino.' Includes an unrelated Matagorda heat-race anecdote.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Alderman Jim Cronin left for the Corbett-Mitchell fight, citing Tom Allen's last letter that Mitchell was fit, and listed Allen among the few St. Louis sports gone to Jacksonville.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Monday Morning, January 22, 1894, page 3.

facts.fact: Allen was listed among the few St. Louis sporting men who had left for the Corbett-Mitchell fight at Jacksonville
